=== Main parts

The naming convention of the parts references in the document.



* The transmission array: The top-mounted section where the antennas are housed. These are responsible for directing the signal and determining the shape of the exclusion zone.

* The processing core: The central chassis containing the frequency generators and signal logic. This is the brain of the device that identifies and prioritizes signal targets.

* The power and cooling block: The base of the unit, which manages the high electrical intake and dissipates the significant heat generated by the amplification modules.
